mi, invariable particle, mid, middle, half.
Joined to the names of the months, or to the
word carême, it forms with them feminine compound
nouns which require the article; la mi-carême;
Mid-Lent; la mi-août; the middle of
August. It may also be joined to the nouns
corps, jambe, chemin, mur, côte, terme, sucre,
when the compound words thus formed require
the preposition à and do not admit of the article:
à mi-côte; half-way up the hill. À —-chemin;
half-way. À —-mât; half-mast high. À —-jambe;
half-way up the leg; past the knees. A
mi-corps; up to the waist. V. mi-parti.
